subcommittees.name: Economic Development, Public Buildings, and Emergency Management Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects telecommunications entities and entities applying to place communications facilities on federal buildings, as well as executive agencies processing applications.
dimensions.evidence: applications for the placement of communications facilities on certain buildings and other property owned by the Federal Government

dimensions.assessment: Standardizes application fees to match direct costs and replaces existing statutory fees with a uniform schedule.
dimensions.evidence: based on the direct costs incurred by an agency in processing a form... Any fee chargeable under this subsection shall supercede any other fee

dimensions.assessment: Fees collected are limited to covering processing costs and require advance appropriations to be available for use.
dimensions.evidence: Any fee collected by an executive agency under this section shall only be available to the extent, and in such amounts, as are provided in advance in appropriation Acts

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Middle Class Tax Relief and Job Creation Act of 2012 to mandate GSA fee schedules and executive agency adoption by regulation.
dimensions.evidence: The head of each executive agency shall adopt by regulation-- (i) fees that correspond to the schedule established by the Administrator

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent fee schedule requirements and federal agency adoption rules.

missing_information: Specific dollar amounts of the uniform fees to be established by the GSA.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the GSA to establish a uniform fee schedule and executive agencies to adopt fees for processing communications facility applications on federal property, superseding other statutes.
